title: Locals risk lives crossing Taksugad after flood washes away bridge
body: Surkhet, September 3 Residents and travellers have been forced to risk their lives to cross the Taksugad stream after floods washed away a bridge and a temporary causeway between wards 10 and 11 of Nalgad Municipality in Jajarkot along the…
